technical.name: technical
technical.description: Pipeline runs end-to-end on real data without fabrication. No biological claim.

static_drug_response.name: static_drug_response
static_drug_response.description: Static cell-line drug-response ranking (GDSC/PRISM/CCLE). No patient claim.

hematologic_specimen_drug_response.name: hematologic_specimen_drug_response
hematologic_specimen_drug_response.description: Specimen-level ex-vivo drug-response ranking on hematologic cancers (BeatAML).

single_cell_state.name: single_cell_state
single_cell_state.description: Disease-state representation learning on public scRNA atlases. Pseudotime only.

sequence_aware.name: sequence_aware
sequence_aware.description: Protein sequences (ESM-2) consumed by downstream heads.

pathway_context.name: pathway_context
pathway_context.description: Reactome pathway membership + STRING PPI + drug-target edges form biological *context* for predictions. NOT a causal mechanism claim.

drug_target_mechanism.name: drug_target_mechanism
drug_target_mechanism.description: Drug-target ChEMBL coverage above gate threshold. Permits drug-class attribution, not causal pathway routing.

survival_prediction.name: survival_prediction
survival_prediction.description: Patient-level survival head technical validation (C-index, Brier, KM).

patient_level_clinical_prediction.name: patient_level_clinical_prediction
patient_level_clinical_prediction.description: Full clinical-outcome prediction with external/temporal holdout AND clinical-only baseline. Requires MORT-FM to add calibrated value beyond a clinical-only Cox.

longitudinal_trajectory.name: longitudinal_trajectory
longitudinal_trajectory.description: Same-patient baseline→followup molecular pairs with real calendar-time labels. Pseudotime is forbidden as a substitute.

resistance_emergence.name: resistance_emergence
resistance_emergence.description: Time-to-resistance prediction under treatment pressure. OS is explicitly forbidden as the sole endpoint.

causal_mechanism.name: causal_mechanism
causal_mechanism.description: Pathway attribution + drug-target edges + CRISPR-perturbation consistency + counterfactual edge ablation + negative controls. The highest bar in the registry.
